title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
body:
We are drowning in information, but we are starving for relevance. Most apps and websites try to solve this by showing you the same trending stories as everyone else. They assume that if a topic is popular, it must be important to you. But that is rarely the case.

True personalization is not about showing you more of what you already click on. It is about understanding the context of your day. It means delivering the stories that actually matter to your life and your work, without the noise of the global outrage cycle.

We built Headlinne to change this dynamic. We use AI to filter out the clutter and focus on the information that respects your time. It is a tool for people who want to stay informed without feeling overwhelmed.
cta: You can see how we are rethinking the daily news experience at HEADLINNE.com.
